title: gate add reads a bare doc file name in an option (tools.md) as a path outside the touches although a touch holds kb/_self/tools.md, and so makes the gate blocking
goal: bl_authority.block_reasons gives no 'outside the touches' reason for an option that names a doc by its bare file name (tools.md, web-sources.md) when a touch of the item ends in that file name, so a provisional gate whose options name the docs its own touches hold stays provisional. Found by the SP-c6tr77jl close retrospective (BG-7po2pir4 g1 was made blocking this way and needed an operator-class answer).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_authority as a;i={"title":"x","touches":["kb/_self/tools.md"]};g={"id":"g1","kind":"provisional","question":"which way?","options":["Drop it","Keep it and reword tools.md"],"recommendation":"Drop it"};r=a.block_reasons(i,g,False);print(r);sys.exit(1 if r else 0)
